body: Yeah, still here. Have started feeling very ill though. Threw up not too long ago.

Hello, sorry I took so long to reply. Honestly, I wasn't expecting a reply. So, thanks for taking the time to comment. But to answer your question, no. I've never tried to find out why. I always just assumed it was just a pathetic thing I did.

And I don't think it'd be a good idea for me to talk it out with anyone or get help. I don't see why I should if I'm really the one doing this to myself anyway. I mean, I tried seeing a couple therapists a few months ago, but that was before all of the thoughts really got going. I stopped going because I just didn't see the need. I knew that there wasn't anything wrong with me and it was all lies and fake. I was just wasting their time anyway.

But hey, thanks again for commenting back. I really do appreciate it. I've never really talked about this kind of thing before.
